text:
julia: quick notes from today's design review for the API Keys area. focusing on: slide-over UX, revoke vs rotate affordance, empty-state phrasing, mobile behavior, and a11y for show-secret + toasts. figma link in the thread.

mike: high-level: i like rotate-first nudges, but ops folks keep reporting accidental rotates when they wanted to revoke. can we reduce the chance of misclicks?

julia: idea: add a tiny secondary confirmation inline when Rotate is clicked with the text 'This will issue a new key and keep scopes. Continue?' with a low-contrast inline cancel so users can step back fast.

aisha: that helps. also suggest adding a small helper near the permissions chips: 'Rotation preserves scopes.' many users ask if scopes are lost.

dan: accessibility: the 'Show secret' icon needs a clear aria-label and must announce state changes. current implementation toggles type attr but doesn't announce. we should add an aria-live region and update aria-expanded on the button.

julia: agreed. proposed label: "Show API secret (reveals sensitive key)." when toggled, aria-live: "API secret revealed" or "API secret hidden".

sam: mobile notes: on narrow screens the slide-over becomes full-screen. need to ensure the revoke button is not stuck under the keyboard on iOS when the secret is visible. also keep primary action reachable by thumb.

mike: good catch. put primary action near bottom with safe area padding and make revoke a text-button at the top of the actions column so it's visible but not the main CTA.

aisha: copy for revoke modal is too soft. current: "Are you sure?" propose: "Revoking this key will immediately stop all services using it. This cannot be undone." primary = Cancel, danger = Revoke key. add small link to "run dependency scan" under the consequence text.

dan: modal a11y: trap focus, add aria-describedby to the revoke button referencing the consequence paragraph, and ensure Escape closes modal. keyboard-only flow must be tested.

julia: empty state debate: 'Create your first key' vs 'Add API key' vs 'Generate key'. which word do users search?

aisha: analytics: support chats show users type "create key" and "generate token" fairly equally. propose CTA: "Create your first key" and subtext: "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely." use 'Generate' in advanced flows.

dan: empty-state image accessibility: include alt="" on decorative svg and ensure heading level is H2 (dashboard H1 elsewhere). CTA must have visible focus ring and 3:1 contrast at least for WCAG AA for large text.

sam: another microflow: when rotating we surface a one-time secret and offer Copy and optional 'Download .env'. we should warn 'You will not be able to see this again. Store it in a secrets manager.' Also offer a small 'Rotate and notify' checkbox (sends a notification to owners).

mike: backend can emit owners list for that checkbox. default unchecked. implementation note: single-show secret must be available only in-memory and not logged.

julia: toast/copy behavior: copy action should show a small toast 'Copied API key' with role=status and aria-live=polite. make sure toasts don't steal focus. include a brief undo affordance for revoke in the UI for 30s? maybe not for security reasons.

dan: undo after revoke is risky. if we offer an undo, it's effectively a delayed revoke. legal prefers explicit revoke without undo. instead we can offer a short-lived 'recently revoked' list in audit logs with timestamp and actor. link to Audit.

aisha: agree. add a line in the revoke modal: 'This action will be recorded in Audit logs.' with link.

julia: small UI nit: the copy-to-clipboard icon currently has tooltip 'Copy'. change to 'Copy secret' and aria-label 'Copy secret to clipboard'. also update the button's aria-pressed state briefly during copy.

sam: keyboard shortcut idea: allow 'k' when focused in key list to open the 'create key' modal. ensure shortcut has discoverability in a small inline hint near the list header.

mike: will be careful with global shortcuts; scope to the keys page only.

julia: action items: i'll update figma with: revised revoke modal copy, rotate inline confirmation, empty state copy, and show-secret a11y patterns. mike to add aria-live and toast behavior and ensure mobile safe-area. dan to run a focused a11y pass and keyboard checks. aisha to consolidate final copy and coordinate with legal about audit language. sam to test mobile layout and keyboard shortcut discoverability.

aisha: i'll post final copy strings here by EOD.

julia: thanks all :sparkles:
